_instructions: TOKEN NOTE: The token here is the same 'OpenClaw Token' value you already set in cli_debrid Settings → AI Assistant.
It is the token OpenClaw uses to authenticate TO cli_debrid — not a separate cli_debrid password.
Authentication is passed as a query parameter (?token=...) rather than an Authorization header, for compatibility with clients that cannot set custom headers.
If you left OpenClaw Token blank in cli_debrid settings, remove the auth block below (the endpoints will be open).
1. Replace <CLI_DEBRID_URL> with your cli_debrid URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.24:5000).
2. Replace <YOUR_OPENCLAW_TOKEN> with the token from cli_debrid Settings → AI Assistant → OpenClaw Token.
3. Copy this file to your OpenClaw config/skills/ directory.
4. Reload OpenClaw and assign this skill to your agent.
5. You can then ask your agent (via Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, etc.): 'What is downloading?', 'Is Breaking Bad collected?', 'Add The Bear to my library'
name: cli_debrid
description: Query and control the cli_debrid media automation application. Provides queue status, library search, recently collected items, and the ability to add titles to the library.

tools.name: queue_status
tools.description: Get the current queue counts (Wanted, Scraping, Adding, Checking, Collecting, Upgrading, Sleeping, Blacklisted) and whether the program is running. Use this when asked 'what is downloading?', 'is the program running?', or 'how many items are in the queue?'

tools.name: library_stats
tools.description: Get library statistics: total collected movies/shows/episodes, total wanted, total blacklisted, and items collected in the last 24 hours. Use this for 'how many movies do I have?', 'what was recently added?'

tools.name: recently_collected
tools.description: List the most recently collected media items with title, year, type, and version. Use this for 'what was just downloaded?', 'show me recent additions'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items to return (default 20, max 50)

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search the collected library by title. Returns matching items with their state (Collected, Wanted, etc.). Use this for 'is X in my library?', 'do I have X?', 'is X collected?'

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by type: 'movie' or 'episode'. Omit for all.

tools.name: add_to_library
tools.description: Add a movie or TV show to the cli_debrid wanted list so it will be downloaded. Use this when asked to 'add X to my library', 'download X', 'request X'. Always confirm with the user before calling this tool.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title of the movie or show

parameters.name: imdb_id
parameters.description: IMDB ID (e.g. tt1234567) — optional, improves accuracy

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Send a message to the user via their configured external notification channels (Discord, Telegram, Apprise, etc.). Use this when the user asks you to send them a notification or alert — for example 'send me a notification about the queue status', 'notify me of the upgrade scan results', or 'send me a reminder'. Always compose a clear, concise message.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The notification body text to send

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Optional title/subject line. Defaults to 'AI Butler'.

example_prompts: How many items are in the queue?
Is Breaking Bad in my library?
How many movies do I have?
Add The Bear (2022) to my library
Send me a notification about the current queue status
Notify me about the upgrade scan results
